options.name: description
options.description: The description of the project. The maximum length is 255 characters.

options.name: environment
options.description: The environment of the projects resources.

options.name: is_default
options.description: If true, all resources will be added to this project if no project is specified.

options.name: name
options.description: The human-readable name for the project. The maximum length is 175 characters and the name must be unique.

options.name: oauth_token
options.description: DigitalOcean OAuth token. Can be specified in C(DO_API_KEY), C(DO_API_TOKEN), or C(DO_OAUTH_TOKEN) environment variables

options.name: purpose
options.description: The purpose of the project. The maximum length is 255 characters Required if state is C(present) If not one of DO provided purposes, will be prefixed with C(Other) DO provided purposes can be found below C(Just trying out DigitalOcean) C(Class project/Educational Purposes) C(Website or blog) C(Web Application) C(Service or API) C(Mobile Application) C(Machine Learning/AI/Data Processing) C(IoT) C(Operational/Developer tooling)

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the target. C(present) will create the project C(absent) will delete the project, if it exists.
